title: Ukunyuka komphuphi
intro: Umphefumlo owawumiselwe ubukhulu, kodwa wavavanywa zizilingo ezinzima, waqalisa uhambo olungaqhelekanga. Indlela yalo mntu yayiphawulwe ngumona, ukwahlukana, kunye nokubandezeleka okungekho sikweni, nto leyo eyaphumela ekubeni abe noxanduva olukhulu kunye nokudibana kwakhona okunzulu. Ungamfumana lo mntu umangalisayo kwiQuran?
clues: Ndandisoloko ndimonelwa ngabantu abasondeleyo kum, nto leyo eyabangela ukuba ndihlukane kakhulu nomzali wam nekhaya lam.
Ndadibana nexesha lobunzima obukhulu, kuquka ukuthengiswa ngexabiso eliphantsi ngabahambi.
Ndatyholwa ngokungekho sikweni ngokwenza okubi ndaza ndachitha iminyaka ndivalelwe entolongweni, kodwa ukholo lwam aluzange lugungqiswe.
Ndanikwa isakhono esikhethekileyo sokutolika imibono enzima, eyaba negalelo elikhulu kwindlela yam eya enkululekweni.
Ubulumko bam kunye nokuthembeka kwam ekugqibeleni kwandikhokelela kwisikhundla esiphezulu segunya kunye nokuthenjwa kwilizwe lasemzini.
Kwiimeko ezininzi, ndadibana kwakhona nomzali wam okhulileyo kunye nabantakwethu emva kokungabikho ixesha elide nelibuhlungu.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَـٰجِدِينَ
verse: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me." (12:4)
